title: New Bounds for the Probability of Causation in Mediation Analysis
sections_checked: §5 conclusions and recommendation to compare bounds
evidence_note: Partial-mediation examples show mediator-informed upper bounds can improve (.76 vs 1) or become wider (.95 vs .88); authors advise computing both and taking the smaller. The 2022 follow-up extends complete-mediation chains and reports modest/asymmetric gains under idealized assumptions.
